'''Gang Tags''', or graffiti tags, are a type of [[Collectibles|collectible item]] in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. [[Carl Johnson]] has to search for a total of 100 gang tags all around [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]] and spray over them the [[Grove Street Families]]' tag with a [[Spray Can|spray can]]. Tags and their basics are first introduced during the mission [[Tagging Up Turf]]. Spraying over an enemy tag increases the player's [[respect]] and respraying all 100 tags is required for [[Completion in GTA San Andreas|completion]] completion. The reward for finishing the work with this collectible are the weapons [[Molotov Cocktail]], [[AK-47]], [[Sawn-off Shotgun]] and [[TEC 9]] delivered to the kitchen at the [[Johnson House]], and Grove Street gang members will start to carry [[Desert Eagle]]s, [[MP5|MP5s]] and [[Knife|knives]] instead of the usual [[pistol]] and [[TEC 9]] .
